## Install

Windows 10/11, x64.

- **Installer:** download `Parla_<version>_x64-setup.exe` below and run it. It installs for your user only (no admin prompt) and adds Parla to the Start menu.
- **Portable:** download `Parla_<version>_x64-portable.zip`, extract the whole folder and run `parla.exe`. Keep `DirectML.dll` next to it.

Parla isn't code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info → Run anyway**. `SHA256SUMS.txt` has the checksums of both files.

Parla runs in the system tray. Open **Settings…** from the tray icon, paste an OpenAI or xAI API key or download the local Parakeet model, then hold **Ctrl+Alt** and talk.
